patch.description: EPIC-17/G04 remains In Progress through admitted V01→V02→V03 and safe merge. Admission: docs/planning/EPIC-17-ADMISSION.md. V01 and V02 are Done; S459 accepts all seven recipes, 73 supported configurations and 146 front/back faces. Woven's 56 local faces pass the approved S457 front mask and local-Y back/band placement. S406's approved view-only collar-over-plackets order remains implemented. V03 is Blocked; no receiver/profile is selected or qualified. CLO 2026.1.310 empirical routes have measured geometry, marks and malformed-input failures; generic OpenCAD R14 is not an industrial apparel profile. The maintainer confirms written product-development/local-DXF permission for the official GetonAgain Free desktop evaluation and authorized its installation. S651 hash-verified its package/manual; S653 reviewed manual pages 239–241, which document mode/options but not DXF entity/layer/version/mark semantics. Two matching Windows consent prompts remain open; installation, installed build and actual local DXF path are not verified. Do not operate the security UI, create/login to an account, or import a fixture before the installed input contract and local route are confirmed. Next: maintainer manually clears the matching prompt, then verify build and local input path and compare the exact receiver contract to a source-exact fixture. Preserve V02-before-V03, legacy DXF behavior and protected export identities, all-seven recipes/options/grades, fixed 0.001 cm geometry, marks, identity, malformed-input, repeatability and rendered-output gates. No ANSI/AAMA or ASTM conformance, physical-fit, factory-acceptance or production-readiness claim. S653 packet: docs/research/epic17/S653-getonagain-dxf-contract-preflight/S653-exit-packet.md.
